brands: A restaurant or venue whose social accounts the team runs. Each has one time zone; every 'today' rule reads it.
users: A person who signs in. They reach every brand of each company they are a member of, while their account is active.
organizations: A company. Each brand belongs to one.
org_members: Who is in which company, as owner, admin or member. Every member reaches every brand of the company; roles decide nothing yet.
posts: One piece of content for several accounts: a reel, a carousel or a story, on a day and time in the brand's zone. Its stage comes from its jobs, or from a stage a person set by hand (marked). Posted is final. A post brought in from the brand's own Instagram or TikTok (post.import) is posted, with its address there (permalink) and its counts (metrics: likes, comments, views, shares, saves) as last read (measured_at).
post_jobs: One account's send of one post: scheduled, uploading, live or failed.
ideas: A plan for a post, with its references and shots. It sits on one calendar day, or is linked to the post it became.
stage: draft, scheduled, posted or failed. Failed means at least one account failed.
story row: Each day holds one planned story, and none once stories went out that day.
channels: The accounts a post goes to: ig (Instagram), tt (TikTok), yt (YouTube), li (LinkedIn), fb (Facebook).
moodboard: Posts a brand's team saved to borrow from, each by key: pasted links, saved posts on the shelf, and pins on a Pinterest board. An idea's inspiration names them by key.
accounts: A brand's own account on a platform, linked by its sign-in: Pinterest so far, whose one picked board the moodboard reads live. One per platform per brand; an account belongs to one brand. Its tokens are sealed and only internal moves read or write it. Not a person's sign-in (account.me).
